basic_details.job_title: ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 15 DEO, Driver and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme Dehradun (ECHS Dehradun)
basic_details.short_information: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS), Dehradun has released a recruitment notification for 15 vacancies of Medical, Para Medical, and Non-Medical Staff posts on a contractual basis. The recruitment includes posts such as Officer In Charge, Medical Specialist, Medical Officer, Lab Technician, Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Data Entry Operator, Driver, and House Keeper. Eligible candidates possessing qualifications ranging from Literate and Class 8 to Graduate, MBBS, MD/MS/DNB, and B.Pharmacy can apply for the respective posts.

age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for specific age limit details for each post. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate (for Officer In Charge), MD/MS/DNB (for Medical Specialist), MBBS (for Medical Officer), BSc/Diploma in Medical Lab Tech (for Lab Tech), DMLT/Class-I Lab Course (for Lab Asst), B Pharmacy/10+2 + Diploma (for Pharmacist), Graduate/Class I Clerical Trade (for Data Entry Operator), Class 8 + MT Driver Course (for Driver), Literate (for House Keeper)
qualification.details: Officer In Charge (Polyclinic Dehradun): Graduate (100% reservation for Armed Forces Retired Officer). Minimum five years of work experience in Health care Institutions or Managerial positions. Medical Specialist (Polyclinic Dehradun): MD/MS in Specialty concerned/DNB (Minimum three years experience). Medical Officer (Polyclinic Dehradun): MBBS (Minimum three years work experience after Internship. Preferable additional Qualification in medicine/surgery). Lab Tech (Polyclinic Dehradun): BSc (Medical Lab Tech) or Matriculation/higher secondary/senior secondary (10+2) with science from recognized Institution/board & Diploma in Medical Lab Tech from a recognized Institution. (Minimum three years work experience in Laboratory). Lab Asst (Polyclinic Dehradun): DMLT/Class-I Laboratory Technical Course (Armed Forces) (Minimum five years work experience in Laboratory). Pharmacist (Polyclinic Dehradun & Vikasnagar): B Pharmacy from recognized Institute or 10+2 with science stream (Physics, Chemistry & Bio) from a recognized board and Approved diploma by pharmacy from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy council of India and registered as Pharmacist under the act 1948 (Minimum three years work experience). Data Entry Operator (MTS) (Polyclinic Dehradun): Graduate/Class I Clerical Trade (Armed Forces). Minimum five years of work experience. Driver (MTS) (Polyclinic Dehradun): Minimum class eighth. Class I MT driver (Armed Forces). Minimum five years work experience as Driver. House Keeper (MTS) (Polyclinic Vikasnagar): Literate. Minimum five years experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Dehradun Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Dehradun Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026 is 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies for Medical/Para Medical/Non-Medical Staff posts in ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the ECHS Dehradun posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 21,800 to Rs. 1,30,000 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from Literate to MD/MS/DNB, MBBS, BSc, Diploma, and Graduate degrees.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Dehradun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website: https://www.echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the interview dates for different posts?
faq.answer: Interview dates are 11 August 2026 for Officer In Charge, Medical Specialist, Medical Officer, Lab Tech, Lab Asst, and 12 August 2026 for Pharmacist, Data Entry Operator, Driver, House Keeper.
